Website privacy

Updated October 27, 2026.

This notice covers the ZeroIT website, not the mobile app.

Website insights

We use Microsoft Clarity to understand page visits, scrolling and clicks through analytics, heatmaps and session recordings. Microsoft processes website interaction and technical information to provide these insights. See Microsoft’s privacy statement and Clarity privacy information.

The website sends denied consent signals for advertising and analytics cookie storage by default. We do not automatically grant cookie consent. Clarity can operate with limited measurement without those cookies; this does not mean no information is sent to Microsoft.

Calculator and FAQ

Calculations and preset FAQ replies run locally. Calculator values, results and FAQ content are explicitly marked for masking in Clarity. Do not enter personal, banking or sensitive information into this illustrative demo. We do not send calculator values or chat messages as custom analytics events.
